name: AI21 Labs
tagline: AI21 Labs is an Israeli AI company known for its Jamba series of models — hybrid architectures combining Mamba state-space layers with transformers for exceptional speed and long-context performance. Its enterprise platform offers document intelligence, text analysis, and custom fine-tuning, with a strong focus on factual accuracy and reduced hallucination. AI21's Wordtune product (the writing assistant) is its most consumer-facing offering, while its API and enterprise deployments serve industries where reliability and grounded outputs are paramount.
